messages:
diane: FYI rolled out dynamic-prefix-evict canary in ap-south-1 at 07:10 IST. Policy: aggressively evict rarely-used prefixes to keep hotset tight on small hosts.

rob: quick numbers?

diane: canary (8% traffic, 07:10-07:40): requests 9.3k, p50 22ms -> 16ms (-27%), p95 260ms -> 190ms (-27%), p99 630ms -> 540ms (-14%). memory pressure on small hosts down ~33%. estimated token-cost -12% overall for this route.

ci-bot: CI: perf-checks passed (runtimes within thresholds), deploy id: d-20260308-09

anita: any client-facing quality issues? evicting prefixes sometimes causes extra recomputation for very long contexts.

diane: we gated the aggressive policy to routes whose median seq len < 220 tokens. long-context routes unaffected. ran a 1.5k-sample eval set; consistency metrics stable. one observed pattern: very long dialogue with rare long-tail prefixes saw a small increase in mid-response latency — bypass rule added: if KV-miss-rate > 12% for a session, switch to conservative eviction.

lee: what's the ramp plan and rollback rules?

diane: ramp: 8% -> 30% in 8h if p95 stays <= 1.5x baseline -> 80% in 36h. auto-rollback triggers: errors > baseline*2 for 5m OR p95 > baseline*1.8 for 3m. manual rollback if customer-dogfood reports regressions.

ops-alert: alert rule created: dyn-prefix-evict/ap-south-1 p95 > baseline*1.5 -> notify @eng-oncall @eng-runtime

rob: any impact on Dedicated pools or billing?
diane: no. this only affects model/kv management within shared runtime. billing unchanged; informing billing team to preempt questions.

anita: can we get a small dashboard tile for "evict hitrate" and "kv-miss-rate" per route? helps oncall quickly decide.

diane: yes — adding Route Analytics tile and a short blurb for Product weekly. action items: add dashboard (diane), extended evals on long-dialogue tails (anita), monitor canary and alerts (ops).

lee: nice win. thanks team. :tada:
